note: This file contains only a module-level data dictionary (CONTINUOUS_EMBEDDINGS) mapping atomic numbers 0-100 to 9-element lists of continuous physicochemical properties (group, period, electronegativity, covalent radius, valence electrons, first ionization energy, electron affinity, block, atomic volume). There are no functions, classes, or callable APIs. No tool-use examples applicable.
summarize_CONTINUOUS_EMBEDDINGS: summarize the CONTINUOUS_EMBEDDINGS dictionary mapping atomic numbers to physicochemical property vectors
review_CONTINUOUS_EMBEDDINGS: review the CONTINUOUS_EMBEDDINGS data structure for CGCNN-like continuous atom embeddings
refactor_CONTINUOUS_EMBEDDINGS: refactor the CONTINUOUS_EMBEDDINGS dictionary to use a more efficient data structure
test_CONTINUOUS_EMBEDDINGS: test the CONTINUOUS_EMBEDDINGS dictionary for NaN values and missing atomic numbers
build_CONTINUOUS_EMBEDDINGS: build a lookup utility to retrieve continuous embedding vectors by atomic number
